text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.23 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their technical background is their experience with "REST API", "Node.js", "React", "Git", and "AWS". Key gaps include a lack of experience with ruby, sql, docker, and ci/cd, as well as having only 3.54 years of experience. Despite these missing requirements and a low overall fit, the application has been escalated for further review.
